results.title: Mexico vs. South Africa—World Cup: Preview, Predictions and Lineups
highlights:
## Mexico Predicted Lineup vs. South Africa
[...]
Mexico has dealt with a few injury concerns heading into the World Cup, but fortunately for El Tri, those issues now appear to be resolved, giving Javier Aguirre a full squad to choose from.
[...]
Expect the center back pairing of César Montes and Johan Vásquez to start, with captain Edson Álvarez anchoring the midfield in front of them as part of what the manager has dubbed the “safety triangle.”
[...]
He is likely to be joined in midfield by Real Betis star Álvaro Fidalgo, while Raúl Jiménez—Mexico’s third all-time top scorer—will almost certainly lead the line, most likely flanked by Alexis Vega on the left and Roberto Alvarado on the right.
[...]
Mexico predicted lineup vs. South Africa (4-3-3): Rangel; Reyes, Montes, Vásquez, Gallardo; Mora, Álvarez, Fidalgo; Alvarado, Jiménez, Vega.
[...]
## South Africa Predicted Lineup vs. Mexico
[...]
Hugo Broos’s South Africa typically lines up in a 4-2-3-1 system, built around structure and balance, with two holding midfielders, wide players providing width, and a central playmaker operating just behind a lone striker.
[...]
Captain Ronwen Williams is the undisputed first-choice goalkeeper and will start, while the defensive setup in front of him is expected to feature Ime Okon and Aubrey Modiba in a central partnership.
[...]
In midfield, Teboho Mokoena is set to play an anchoring role, likely alongside Sphephelo Sithole.
[...]
Further forward, Oswin Appollis and Lyle Foster—the team’s primary attacking threat—are regular starters and expected to play important roles in the final third.
[...]
South Africa predicted lineup vs. Mexico (4-2-3-1): Williams; Muadu, Okon, Makhanya, Modiba; Sithole, Mokoena; Moremi, Zwane, Appollis; Foster.

results.title: Mexico vs South Africa: World Cup opener preview
highlights:
Mexico’s projected XI on Sofascore lines up in a 4-1-2-3 with Raúl Rangel in goal and a back four of Israel Reyes, César Montes, Johan Vázquez and Jesús Gallardo. Erik Lira is the anchor in front of the defense, with Brian Gutiérrez and Álvaro Fidalgo providing the link to attack. Roberto Alvarado and Julián Quiñones can stretch the line, while Raúl Jiménez gives a strong target in the box. The shape allows Mexico to press high, keep the ball, and fire early crosses from both flanks. Set pieces should also matter with Montes and Vázquez attacking deliveries.
[...]
South Africa are listed in a 4-2-3-1 with Ronwen Williams in goal and a back four of Khuliso Mudau, Ime Okon, Mbekezeli Mbokazi and Aubrey Modiba. Teboho Mokoena partners Jayden Adams in midfield to control second balls and start transitions. Oswin Appollis, Themba Zwane and Relebohile Mofokeng bring dribbling and movement behind striker Lyle Foster. Expect quick counters, diagonal switches to isolate fullbacks, and late arrivals from Zwane. Williams’ distribution can also launch breaks when Mexico push numbers forward.
[...]
Squad value tips toward Mexico. Sofascore lists the projected starting XI of El Tri at 89.2M €, while South Africa’s sits at 27.5M €. The most valuable players are Erik Lira at 13.2M € for Mexico and Lyle Foster at 10.3M € for Bafana Bafana. Rankings reflect a similar gap, with Mexico at 15 and South Africa at 60. Head to head is tight over a small sample: Mexico have 2 wins, South Africa 1, and 1 draw, including the 1-1 at the 2010 World Cup.
